scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp -R public/. dist/ && node --experimental-strip-types build-config.ts dist "${MEDICINE_ENABLE_OCR:-enabled}"
scripts.verify-dist: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir "$tmp" && cp -R public/. "$tmp"/ && node --experimental-strip-types build-config.ts "$tmp" "${MEDICINE_ENABLE_OCR:-enabled}" && diff -ru "$tmp" dist
